proposal.explanation: The original code had several functional defects: (1) missing declarations for signals used in the main sequential block (pre_rsp_state, second_rsp_state, ready_for_response_token, r_err_token, nonzero_out), causing synthesis errors. (2) A duplicate always block assigning r_rsp_state creating multiple drivers. (3) An always block incorrectly assigning nonzero_out as a sequential signal instead of combinational. (4) Declarations of ready_for_response_token and second_rsp_state placed in the middle of the code instead of the declaration region. The repairs add missing declarations in the declaration region, remove the duplicate r_rsp_state block, convert nonzero_out to a combinational wire, and clean up misplaced declarations. These changes preserve the public interface, parameters, and configured behavior while fixing synthesis and functional issues.
